items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The other band, Jules Buffano, and them, they were on the JS.

ctx.x: The other band, Jules Buffano, and them, they were on the JS. They have two boats, see, in St. Louis at the time. The JS, they got the society crowd, and the St. Paul got the ordinary --
JS. What did that stand for?
